description: This Java source file defines the ConfigXMLReader class and related nested classes, responsible for reading, parsing, and managing XML configuration files for web application controllers within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading controller configurations, handling includes, and retrieving request mappings and view configurations.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader
classes.description: Main class for reading and parsing XML site configuration files, including nested classes for controller configuration, events, request mappings, responses, user messages, and view mappings.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ControllerConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a controller, including request mappings, view mappings, events, includes, and general settings loaded from XML.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.Event
classes.description: Represents an event within a controller, including type, path, invoke, transaction settings, and metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestMap
classes.description: Represents a request mapping, including URI, method, security settings, associated event, responses, and metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to a request, including name, type, value, status code, and redirect parameters.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponseUserMessage
classes.description: Represents a user message associated with a request response, including resource, value, and source field.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ViewMap
classes.description: Represents a view mapping, including name, page, type, content type, encoding, security options, and description.

methods.name: getEmptyNoneRequestResponse
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty request response with type 'none'.

methods.name: findControllerFilesWithRequest
methods.description: Finds controller XML files that contain a specific request URI, optionally filtered by controller partial path.

methods.name: findControllerRequestUniqueForTargetType
methods.description: Finds unique controller request identifiers based on target string and URL mode ('intra-app' or 'inter-app').

methods.name: getControllerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the controller configuration for a given WebappInfo or URL, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getControllerConfigURL
methods.description: Gets the URL of the controller configuration XML file from the ServletContext.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML document from a URL, returning the root element.
